notes.note: Reviewed the desktop-release-notes GitHub request boundary, its generation/publication CLI callers, nightly-native-cohort ordering and regression tests. This checkpoint only adds bounded allowlisted validation messages, request IDs and permission headers with token and notes redaction. Exact-source/tag guards, publication effects, failure status and single-attempt behavior are unchanged, so the guide and entry-point claims remain accurate without prose changes. Regressions failed on the old owner (3 failures) and all 11 owner tests passed after repair; lint exited zero with inherited advisory diagnostics. No archive retry or provider mutation was performed, and the original 422 cause remains unconfirmed.
